context.fr: Vendredi 20 mars 2020. Le Covid ferme les pays un à un, et l'ETF Monde a perdu 32 % en cinq semaines. Tu as 10 000 $ placés dessus.
context.en: Friday 20 March 2020. Covid is closing countries one after another, and the world ETF has lost 32% in five weeks. You have $10,000 in it.

upside.fr: Si les cours remontent, tu en profites en entier.
upside.en: If prices recover, you get all of it.

downside.fr: Si la baisse continue, tu perds davantage.
downside.en: If the fall goes on, you lose more.

upside.fr: Si la baisse continue, tu limites la perte.
upside.en: If the fall goes on, you limit the loss.

downside.fr: Si les cours remontent, tu n'en profites qu'à moitié.
downside.en: If prices recover, you only get half of it.

explanation.fr: Ce jour-là, personne ne savait que le marché toucherait son plus bas trois jours plus tard. Fin février 2021, l'ETF Monde avait regagné 70 % depuis le 20 mars : ceux qui avaient vendu avaient figé leur perte, ceux qui avaient gardé l'avaient effacée. Rien ne garantissait ce {{rebond|rebond}} : après 2008, il avait fallu plusieurs années.
explanation.en: That day, nobody knew the market would hit its low three days later. By late February 2021, the world ETF had gained 70% from 20 March: those who had sold had locked in their loss, those who had held had wiped it out. Nothing guaranteed that {{rebond|rebound}}: after 2008, it had taken several years.
